signal_contract: SignalEvent is an OBSERVATION only (origin constrained to a fixed vocabulary, provenance required). InferenceRecord is a SEPARATE, explicitly DERIVED record type citing source_signal_ids -- verified structurally to carry no is_buyer/opportunity_value-shaped field (test_inference_is_a_distinct_record_type_from_signal).
problem_hypothesis_contract: hypothesis_id/source_signal_ids/description/evidence_for/evidence_against/missing_evidence/confidence (trajectory.py's CONFIDENCE_* levels)/possible_cost_dimensions (9-item controlled vocabulary, monetary cost never required)/status (PROPOSED/ACCEPTED/REJECTED, rejection supported).
objective_contract: desired_state/current_state/required_capability_ids/constraints/success_conditions/failure_conditions/authority_ceiling/evidence_required/reversibility/external_effects_allowed/economic_context -- structurally verified to carry no prompt/instructions field, and required_capability_ids is validated to be a subset of authority_ceiling whenever a ceiling is declared.
differential_cognition_result: Implemented as DifferentialCognitionEngine with 5 default, fully swappable, purely deterministic Python-function perspectives (PRIMARY/ADVERSARIAL/ALTERNATIVE/COMMERCIAL/GOVERNANCE) -- none calls any model, local or remote, so the engine is trivially provider-neutral. Proven deterministic (same objective -> byte-identical non-timestamp output across two runs) and swappable (a single custom perspective dict runs standalone).
contradiction_preservation_result: ContradictionMap computes agreement as the FULL intersection of proposed_actions across all perspectives (a strict, honest definition -- unanimity, not majority) and disagreement as everything outside it; SynthesisRecord.preserved_disagreement is always exactly ContradictionMap.disagreement, never edited down. Proven even under total agreement (a 3-perspective unanimous scenario) that every contributing perspective's own record_id remains individually traceable via perspective_record_ids -- CONSENSUS != TRUTH is enforced structurally (no field on SynthesisRecord collapses multiple claims into one 'the answer'), not merely asserted in a docstring.
capability_graph_result: Durable JSONL ledger (evidence_envelope.envelope discipline), 6-state lifecycle (DISCOVERED/CANDIDATE/DEMONSTRATED/OPERATIONALLY_PROVEN/COMMERCIALLY_PROVEN/TRANSFER_PROVEN), 5 evidence dimensions (TECHNICAL/GOVERNANCE/OPERATIONAL/COMMERCIAL/TRANSFER) each independently tracked (NOT_EVIDENCED/PARTIAL/EVIDENCED, no arbitrary numeric score), dependency edges (requires_capability_ids) gating availability transitively. Proven to survive process restart with lifecycle_state, its reason (naming the promotion decision_id that produced it), and version() (a monotonically increasing transition count) all reconstructable from a freshly constructed CapabilityGraph object over the same directory.
workflow_compiler_result: WorkflowCompiler.compile() partitions an objective's required_capability_ids into existing (available + dependency-satisfied) / composable (satisfiable via a caller-declared composition of available capabilities) / missing. A missing capability is NEVER hallucinated into the plan -- it becomes a CapabilityGapRecord naming a smallest_bounded_experiment. WorkflowPlan.is_executable is False whenever any capability is missing.
capability_gap_result: CapabilityGapRecord(gap_id, missing_capability_id, objective_id, smallest_bounded_experiment, status=OPEN). Proven produced automatically and exactly once per missing capability_id by WorkflowCompiler.compile().
foundry_result: CapabilityFoundry.run_probe() distinguishes TOOL CREATED from CAPABILITY DEMONSTRATED by construction: a successful probe registers TECHNICAL evidence and resolves the gap, but NEVER itself advances lifecycle_state past DISCOVERED -- promotion to CANDIDATE or higher always requires a separate CapabilityPromotionGate.evaluate()+apply_promotion() call, proven in test_promotion_to_demonstrated_requires_separate_gate_call and in the full synthetic organism e2e test (auto_acknowledge_reply reaches CANDIDATE via Foundry, stays there, and is correctly excluded from the executable workflow).
promotion_gate_result: CapabilityPromotionGate.evaluate() returns PROMOTE only when every evidence dimension a (configurable, per-capability-class) policy names for the requested state is EVIDENCED; otherwise NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE (missing/partial evidence) or REJECT (backward/non-forward request). apply_promotion() is the ONLY code path in the module permitted to call CapabilityGraph._set_lifecycle_state() -- proven that a capability with code registered in fabric.CAPABILITIES and zero recorded evidence does NOT promote merely by existing (test_code_existing_or_a_test_running_is_not_by_itself_promotion).
reachability_result: ReachabilityEngine performs deterministic dependency-graph reasoning only (no model call) over a caller-declared objective_classes map (class_name -> required capability_ids). Proven: a class becomes newly_reachable only once EVERY required capability in it is independently available+dependency-satisfied (promoting one of two does not fabricate reachability for the class -- proven both narrowly and inside the full synthetic e2e test); an already-satisfied class is never re-reported; every ReachabilityDelta carries capability_graph_version, proven attributable to a freshly restarted CapabilityGraph's own version() count.
memory_architecture: Six classes per Section 18, realized as FOUR stores (not six parallel implementations): CapabilityGraph IS the CAPABILITY memory class; EvidenceLedger IS the EVIDENCE memory class (both already required by Sections 8/12 -- not duplicated for Section 18). EPISODIC/SEMANTIC/PROCEDURAL are three JSONL ledgers inside MemoryStore built on the same _AppendOnlyLedger primitive. TRUST_RELATIONSHIP is a READ-ONLY VIEW method (MemoryStore.trust_relationship_status()) over the real fabric.interface.PairingStore/PeerIdentityStore -- proven to reflect a live revocation immediately, never a stale copy. 'MEMORY WRITE != MEMORY PROMOTION' is an enforced MemoryPromotionError, not a comment: promote_to_semantic()/promote_to_procedural() both refuse without at least one cited EvidenceRecord whose provenance is OBSERVED, SYSTEM_ASSERTED, or AUTHORIZED_CONCLUSION (never a bare UNVERIFIED_INTERPRETATION) -- proven in both directions (refusal and success) and exercised for real in the synthetic e2e test.
event_fabric: substrate/event_fabric.py defines MessageEnvelope + 10 builder functions for all required message families (COMMAND/EVENT/ARTIFACT/MEMORY_DELTA/CAPABILITY_ADVERTISEMENT/WORKFLOW/RESULT/EVIDENCE_RECEIPT/HEARTBEAT/STATE_SUMMARY), each carrying the common metadata Section 19 lists. It is envelope SHAPES only -- no delivery/transport code -- deliberately not duplicating RemoteCapabilityRequest's own signed fields (a COMMAND envelope names the real fabric request by fabric_request_id rather than re-specifying relationship_id/integrity_tag/etc). Semantic separation proven structurally and by test: an EVENT envelope has no capability_id/fabric_request_id field at all (cannot be mistaken for a COMMAND); a HEARTBEAT's payload is exactly {'alive': True} (carries nothing authority-relevant); a MEMORY_DELTA's payload always states promoted:false and receiving one changes nothing in MemoryStore until a separate, evidence-gated promote_to_*() call succeeds; a CAPABILITY_ADVERTISEMENT is a plain dataclass with no invoke()/execute() method at all.
capability_advertisement: build_capability_advertisement() covers the full Section 22 shape (peer_id via source_peer_id, capability_id, version, input_contract, output_contract, authority_requirement, availability, evidence_requirement, capability_state). No automatic remote execution from an advertisement is implemented, per Section 22's own instruction.
governance_invariants: GovernanceEngine.decide() is the ONLY function in substrate/interface.py that produces a GovernanceDecision -- proven by a structural test that no other class in the module (WorkflowPlan, DifferentialCognitionEngine, CapabilityGraph, WorkflowCompiler, ObjectiveContract) defines a `decide` method. Its signature accepts only a WorkflowPlan and a real fabric.interface.AuthorityContext -- it cannot read economic_context, differential-cognition output, or capability advertisements because its signature has no parameter for them, proven with an objective declaring a large economic_context that is still DENIED when authority is not granted. execute_workflow_step() is the ONLY function that may call fabric.interface.process_remote_capability_request(), and it raises GovernanceError (never executes) both when the decision is not APPROVED and when the decision's workflow_plan_id does not match the plan being executed.
evidence_invariants: EvidenceRecord.provenance is drawn from evidence_envelope.trajectory's PROVENANCE_KINDS and evidence_dimension from the fixed 5-item vocabulary; no field permits a bare, untagged assertion. CapabilityPromotionGate never promotes on the existence of code/a single passing test alone -- it requires the evidence LEDGER to record EVIDENCED for each dimension the target state's policy names.
commercial_evidence_invariants: OutcomeRecord requires all four dimensions (technical_success/operational_success/customer_acceptance/economic_result) to be explicitly ACHIEVED/NOT_ACHIEVED/UNKNOWN/FAILURE -- never silently omitted. Commercial evidence is a separate evidence_dimension ('COMMERCIAL') from TECHNICAL/GOVERNANCE/OPERATIONAL/TRANSFER, and CapabilityPromotionGate's default policy requires COMMERCIAL evidence only for COMMERCIALLY_PROVEN and above -- a capability can be OPERATIONALLY_PROVEN (and thus available for real internal use) without ever needing commercial evidence, keeping 'technically valid' and 'economically useful' independently provable.

counterevidence: This is an entirely LOCAL, SYNTHETIC proof. No real customer, no real Donab engagement, no real payment, no real LinkedIn signal, and no real Google/external provider was contacted or represented as contacted.

The synthetic e2e test's 'missing capability' (auto_acknowledge_reply) is a naming placeholder probed by a trivial in-process lambda -- it demonstrates the FOUNDRY MECHANISM honestly, not a real new ForgeWorld ability; it is deliberately left at CANDIDATE, never claimed DEMONSTRATED.

ReachabilityEngine's objective_classes map is caller-declared in every test -- this mission does not yet auto-derive objective classes from a corpus of real objectives; that remains future work if wanted.

DifferentialCognitionEngine's five perspectives are deliberately simple, deterministic heuristics, not model-backed reasoning of any kind -- calling them 'cognition' describes their architectural ROLE (independent perspective-taking before synthesis), not a claim of actual reasoning depth; a future microphase may plug in real model-backed perspective functions without changing this engine's contract.
